TUMexchange Acceptance Chances

Explore historical admission chances and check partner university requirements for TUMexchange. Filter by country, degree level, or subject area.

How to read the bars

What the bars mean

Full bar (100%): All applicants were accepted (places exceeded applicants, or no one applied that year).

Partial bar: Shows the percentage of applicants accepted (for example, 50% means half of applicants got a place).

Competition fluctuates each semester based on applicant volume and student grades; past rates serve as a helpful guide, not an admission guarantee.
